CustomField.label: Contact Card Picture
CustomField.description: Shepherd-style download path of the avatar ContentVersion most recently uploaded for this Contact. Stamped by Skywave_SaveProfile after a successful avatar upload. Read by the Modern Contact Card LWC on the Skywave Contact record page. Locking the URL into a field (rather than re-resolving from ContentDocumentLink at read time) avoids ambiguity when a Contact has multiple historical avatar uploads.
